description: One timed lesson of mixed chat practice. The backend stores `target_minutes` beside it.

goal_context.description: The real reading/writing situation from the learner's goal used today, e.g. 'a status email'.
goal_context.title: Goal Context

grammar_focus.description: One grammar point and why it matters for the learner's goal.
grammar_focus.title: Grammar Focus

lesson_goal.description: One sentence: what the learner can do after this lesson.
lesson_goal.title: Lesson Goal

new_vocabulary.description: Words or phrases to teach today, in the target language: about 3-4 for a 10-minute lesson, 6-10 for 30 minutes or more. Later lessons review them.
new_vocabulary.title: New Vocabulary

practice_targets.description: 2-4 observable things to get right today. Used for praise and checks, not to end the lesson.
practice_targets.title: Practice Targets

review_patterns.description: pattern_type values of due mistakes to retest today, copied exactly. Empty if none are due.
review_patterns.title: Review Patterns

title: LessonCurriculum
